bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="$root/.worktrees/bug-report-cfc999ac-20261115"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = cfc999ac40962b936c6dbe83648d0d2fab421fdd || exit 61
test -f "$root/deploy/secrets/bug_report_recipient.txt" || exit 62
container="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' | head -n1)"
test -n "$container" || exit 63
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$container")"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$container")" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bugreport-cfc999ac)" || exit 64
docker logs --since 10m "$container" 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' || exit 65
umask 077
log="$(mktemp /tmp/gace-posting-menu-bugreport.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -f "$log"' EXIT
docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" run --rm --no-deps -e MENU_PUBLISH_PANEL_TYPES=posting gaybbs node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/publishMenuPanels.mjs >"$log" 2>&1 || { echo BUGREPORT_MENU_PUBLISH_FAILED; exit 66; }
python3 - "$log" <<'PY'
import json,sys
rows=[]
for line in open(sys.argv[1]):
 try:x=json.loads(line)
 except (ValueError,TypeError):continue
 if x.get("panel_type")=="posting" and "message_id" in x:
  rows.append(int(x["chat_id"]))
expected={-1003847210571,-1002373696859,-1003770334893}
if set(rows)!=expected or len(rows)!=3:sys.exit(67)
print("GAYBBS_POSTING_PANELS=3_OF_3")
print("BUG_REPORT_LAST_ROW=11")
PY
echo GAYBBS_BUG_REPORT_MENU_PUBLISH=PASS
